content: {"body":"For a single-user desktop app, SQLite is my position: it's embedded, zero-configuration, transactional, and battle-tested, giving you real SQL power without any server process or sync headaches. Unless the app's data model is trivially a few config values (then JSON files suffice), SQLite's single-file storage is the right default — it scales from a notes app to a local photo library without changing your architecture.","declared_relations":[]}
